name: tracker-session-cleanup
goal: Release capacity for finished runs, sweep proven idle owned panes after the grace period, and surface flagged requests in autolaunch status.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Finished runs leave live panes counted at the nine-slot cap, and flagged items bypass scheduler waits.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Keep retained legacy and managed inventory live after completion, age the flagged request, and verify no close before ten minutes or while busy.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 6500add49d failed the new flagged-status, capacity, and retained-pane cleanup assertions.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Match terminal run and pane identities, check local owner and provider idleness after grace, and map unresolved flags from the journal.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
